passage: Sam went for a walk in the park. He went through the big gate and down the path. He looked out at the pond. "I think there is a duck," he said. There it was, on a big rock. Sam sat on the grass to look.
Biscuit ran through the tall grass. I think he saw a frog there. There it went, hop, hop, through the fence. Biscuit sat down to think about that frog.

Priya hid, and I did not know where to look. Biscuit ran through the hall, and I think he knew which way to go. There she was, under the bed with her toy dinosaur. Now it was my turn, and Priya had to think where I went. I ran through the door and hid there, as still as a rock. Which one of us will Biscuit find first?
